text.title: Scattered Scouts
text.body: Scattered frontier outriders are pinned across the salt scrub. Relieve the isolated patrols, establish defensive perimeter lines, and push through the raider cordons.
text.obj.0: Reach all three watchposts and rescue the trapped scouts
text.obj.1: Break the raider packs holding the watchposts
text.msg.1: Signal fires burn at three posts—north-west, north-east and south-east. Move swiftly.
text.msg.2: The north-west post is clear! Our rangers are stepping out to join the column.
text.msg.3: The north-east garrison is free and armed.
text.msg.4: That is the third watchpost relieved—even our field mage made it through.
text.msg.5: Every scout team is back under the banner. The basin reports are in our hands.
text.win: All three scout posts are relieved and the surviving rangers join your march.
text.fail.1: Your hero has fallen in the Bracken Basin.
